verdict.rationale: Ente Auth is a 2FA code authenticator, not a platform where users build automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a category error for this product. Its daily local backups, trash recovery, and CLI export apply to the 2FA codes themselves. They are not versioned automations, so the exception for wrong-axis capabilities does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
